title: Breast cancer screening examinations in women after Hodgkin's lymphoma therapy in childhood and adolescence (HD-78 to HD interval studies) with radiotherapy including areas of the mammary gland
summary: Patients after radiation of Hodgkin´s disease (HD) show an increased rate of secondary cancers. Women exhibit a higher frequency of secondary breast carcinomas after radiation including the breast area. National and international experts demand a structured breast cancer surveillance program for women after radiation of the breast area during childhood and adolescence. Women after radiation and women with hereditary risk for breast cancer share characteristic features (early age of onset, elevated risk for breast cancer). The German Consortium for Hereditary Breast and Ovarian cancer established a multimodal breast cancer surveillance program. This program will be offered to women after radiation of HD in childhood and adolescence.

interventions.name:
Women after radiation of hodgkin´s disease in childhood and adolescence including breast area from 25 years of age:
- Instruction for self-examination of the breast 
- Every 6 months medical examination of the breast and mammasonography
- Every 12 months magnetic resonance imaging of the breast

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Main inclusion criteria:
- ≥ 25 years
- female 
- radiation including breast area in childhood and adolescence due to HD at the age of 9 - 17 years
- no contraindication against one of the diagnostic procedures
- able to give informed consent
Exclusion criteria:
- ≥ 50 years of age
- pregnancy, lactation
- contraindication for MRI of the breast (e.g. contrast agent allergy, pacemaker, defibrillator, epicardial wires, certain cochlear and ocular implants and heart valves, magnetically activated tissue expanders, tattoos containing metal in the examination area or osteosynthesis material due to the risk of overheating, patient at risk of nephrogenic systemic fibrosis)
